summary_en: On November 12, 2026, the board authorized the acquisition of up to 115,000 shares (1.43% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) at the closing price of 1,824 yen per share through a ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange transaction on November 13, 2026, for a total outlay not exceeding 209.76 million yen.
summary_jp: 115,000株（発行済株式数に対する割合1.43%）を、終値1,824円でToSTNeT-3により2026年11月13日に買付けるもので、買付金額の上限は2億9,760万円。

summary_en: 200,000 shares (2.4% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired over ¥500M limit. Acquisition window 10 Aug 2026 to 30 Apr 2027. Method: open-market purchases and ToSTNeT-3. Authorized under Articles of Incorporation and Companies Act Article 165(2).
